description: One screening verdict. Append-only: the raw content is never stored, only a hash of it, so the record is safe to keep forever and safe to share with a reviewer.

fields.description: Where in the turn this verdict was reached.
fields.label: Boundary

fields.description: The screening stage that produced the verdict, e.g. pii, injection, tool-policy.
fields.label: Stage

fields.description: What the screen actually did. Log = recorded only; Flag = recorded and surfaced for review; Block = the content was stopped.
fields.label: Action

fields.description: Set on insert; the creation timestamp is the audit trail.
fields.label: Detected At

fields.description: The rule pack entry that fired, when the detection came from the pack.
fields.label: Rule

fields.description: Snapshot of the rule's type, kept so the event still reads correctly after the rule is edited or removed.
fields.label: Rule Type

fields.description: The pattern expression that matched — the rule's signature, never the user's text.
fields.label: Matched Pattern

fields.description: Name of the classifier or detector that fired when the detection did not come from the rule pack, e.g. a PII detector label.
fields.label: Classifier

fields.description: SHA-256 of the screened content. Lets two events be recognised as the same input without keeping the input.
fields.label: Content Hash

fields.description: Character count of the screened content — useful for triage, reveals nothing.
fields.label: Content Length

fields.description: Non-identifying summary, e.g. "2x CIVIL_ID". Must never contain the screened text — the controller rejects an event whose detail looks like raw content.
fields.label: Detail

name: AI Security Event
